hints.title: Total Sum Check
hints.text: If the sum of all elements in nums is less than target, it is impossible to form the target subsequence, so return -1.

hints.title: Bit by Bit Needs
hints.text: Inspect the binary representation of target from lowest bit to highest bit. Track available accumulated sums from smaller powers of 2.

hints.title: Greedy Split
hints.text: When the i-th bit of target is needed but current accumulated sum is insufficient, find the smallest available power of 2 greater than 2^i and repeatedly divide it, adding splits to the count.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: General subset sum is NP-complete, but powers of 2 permit greedy bit-level splitting.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(32) bucket array for counting available powers of two.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use binary decomposition and greedy splitting of higher powers.
